description: This file contains the implementation of PyTorch's DistributedDataParallel (DDP) module, which provides distributed data parallelism for training neural networks across multiple processes and devices. It includes classes, functions, and hooks to manage distributed synchronization, gradient reduction, mixed precision training, and related utilities.

classes.name: DistributedDataParallel
classes.description: A class implementing PyTorch's distributed data parallel training mechanism, managing synchronization of gradients, parameters, buffers, and hooks across multiple processes and devices.

classes.name: _MixedPrecision
classes.description: A dataclass configuring mixed-precision training settings within DDP, including data types for parameters, buffers, and gradient reduction.

classes.name: _BufferCommHook
classes.description: Dataclass encapsulating a communication hook callable and its state, used for custom distributed communication behaviors.

classes.name: _DDPJoinHook
classes.description: A hook class derived from JoinHook, coordinating join operations for DDP during distributed training.

classes.name: _DDPSink
classes.description: A custom autograd function used to synchronize gradients and manage backward hooks when training with DDP.
